{"description":"## Trust Model Requirements Extracted from spec/06-security.md

### Section 8.7 Key Management - Key Derivation

**MUST requirements:**
- [ ] All nodes derive material from a single 32-byte seed (keypair, IID, 02xx addr, X25519)
- [ ] Derivation MUST match test vectors exactly (test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json)
- [ ] IID = SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L bit cleared; MUST be SHA-512, not SHA-256
- [ ] 02xx Address lower 64 bits MUST equal IID (binds key to address, prevents substitution)
- [ ] X25519 clamping per RFC 7748 section 5 REQUIRED for security

### Section 8.7 Key Management - TOFU (Trust On First Use)

- [ ] Implementations MUST support TOFU
- [ ] Key MUST match the one that derives the observed IID/02xx address
- [ ] Key change or IID mismatch -> MUST reject and alert

### Section 8.7 Key Management - BR-Provisioned (optional)

Security Requirements:
- [ ] Channel MUST be encrypted and authenticated
- [ ] All derived addresses (02xx, IID) MUST match key

### Section 8.7 Key Management - Key Rotation

- [ ] Nodes SHOULD support key rotation announcements
- [ ] Key change with valid signature from old key -> accept new key
- [ ] Key change without signature -> MUST reject, require re-verification

### Section 8.4 Signed vs Relay-Mutable Fields (Root validation)

- [ ] Root MUST validate in this order: structural framing and active instance/DODAG context; pinned key, IID, transcript, and origin signature; per-key replay classification; semantic parsing; exact self /128 Target validation; persistence of a fresh replay floor; and atomic in-memory route mutation

### Section 15.2 Key Storage

- [ ] Private keys MUST be stored in: Hardware secure element (preferred) OR Flash with readout protection
- [ ] Private keys MUST never be transmitted over the air"}

Extracted 15 MUST/SHALL/SHOULD/REQUIRED requirements from spec/06-security.md sections 8.4, 8.7, and 15.2 covering key derivation (5), TOFU (3), BR-provisioned security (2), key rotation (3), root validation order (1), and key storage (1). Checklist added to issue description.
